						EXPECTED_STATE = 2
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_cp_r_operation_total
						has_variable = zg361_cp_r_operation_used
						has_variable = zg361_cp_project_object_manager
						has_variable = zg361_cp_project_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_cp_project_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_cp_project_object_origin_case
						has_variable = zg361_cp_project_object_version
						has_variable = zg361_cp_project_object_deadline_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_cp_project_object_status
					}
					var:zg361_cp_r_operation_used < var:zg361_cp_r_operation_total
					var:zg361_cp_project_object_manager = $TICKET_OWNER$
					var:zg361_cp_project_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					var:zg361_cp_project_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_last_red_code value = 1343 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED; no receipt, business or resource write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_r_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_r_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_r_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_r_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_r_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_r_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 2
			}
			OR = {
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 2
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 2
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cp_m134_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 2
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
